findings.description: Reference number display has no fallback if API fails to return the field, leaving the payment step showing empty text.
WhatsApp phone number (+94768644132) is hardcoded in the component and not environment-configurable.
API response schema mismatch could cause reference number to fail silently if the field name changes from reference_number.
No idempotency protection on order confirmation; rapid clicking could submit duplicate orders before the submitting state updates.
findings.location: confirmOrder() function and button disabled state

findings.description: Sensitive data (delivery address, phone, order total) stored plaintext in localStorage accessible to any page script. Should use session storage or encryption.
Order confirmation snapshots cartItems but doesn't validate cart hasn't been modified since checkout started.
Bank copy buttons lack keyboard affordance (no focus ring); keyboard-only users won't know fields are interactive.
Progress save failures (localStorage full or blocked) are silent; users see the 'Saved' badge even if save failed.
